gloss: to devote oneself to; to throw oneself into

definitions.gloss: to devote oneself to; to throw oneself into; to enter (a field or cause)
definitions.explanation: To commit oneself wholeheartedly to a cause, profession, or activity. Implies entering a new world or field with dedication.

definitions.gloss: to throw oneself (physically); to jump into
definitions.explanation: To physically leap or jump into something, such as water or a dangerous situation.

notes:
Idiomatic expression composed of ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (body, self) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{投|とう}じる→投じる：19592_toujiru⟧ (to throw, to cast). Literally "to throw one's body/self into." The figurative sense (devoting oneself) is more common than the literal sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{投|とう}じる: to enter politics
- ⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{投|とう}じる: to throw oneself into battle
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{投|とう}じる: to devote oneself to a business venture
- ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{身|み}を{投|とう}じる: to devote oneself to art

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{身|み}を{捧|ささ}げる→身を捧げる：25428_miwosasageru⟧: to dedicate oneself — emphasizes sacrifice and service
- ⟦{打|う}ち{込|こ}む→打ち込む：04229_uchikomu⟧: to throw oneself into — more casual, used for hobbies and interests
- ⟦{専念|せんねん}する→専念する：25369_sennensuru⟧: to concentrate on — more neutral, less dramatic
